summary: Dynamic reinspection v0.9 treated any non-empty string as a valid evidence key, content fingerprint, or provenance identity. Whitespace-only or control-only strings could therefore satisfy tuple validity and, when previously unseen, contribute to quarantine reactivation despite carrying no usable identity.
risk: quarantine reactivation from malformed identity material
resolution: Identity tuple members must remain non-empty after trimming and reject ASCII control characters while preserving original tuple positions. Ordinary valid identities remain eligible for provenance-bound reinspection; malformed identity material cannot reactivate quarantine.
promotionBoundary: Resolved only after focused adversarial CI and the full cross-organ integration path succeeded. Public display remains separately gated by post-resolution CI/deployment evidence.
